title: Normalised RC Event
description: Event model for a robotic cell, as produced by the normaliser

id.description: Unique identifier generated by the normaliser as: cellId + timestamp + eventType

cellId.description: Unique identifier for the robotic cell

timestamp.description: Event timestamp normalised to UTC ISO 8601

eventType.description: Canonical event type, normalised from raw telemetry

payload.description: Event-specific data from the raw telemetry event. Structure varies by event type.

raw.description: Original event as received from the telemetry source, stored unmodified for auditing. Absent for events synthesised by the ingest function.
